relationships.subject: Berberine
relationships.evidence_quote: A high dose of BBR can reverse the expression of NF-κB induced by CDDP

key_findings: Berberine alleviated cisplatin-induced thermal and mechanical hyperalgesia and reduced DRG TRPV1 and NF-κB overexpression; TRPV1 knockout reduced berberine's early-stage protection.
Berberine lowered serum NF-κB, NGF, IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α and raised IL-10 independently of TRPV1.
